report:
Ad-hoc incremental snapshot not working

Hi,
I have been trying to initiate an ad-hoc incremental snapshot on a table not previously handled by our Debezium Oracle CDC connector, but I cannot get it to work.
We are trying out the 2.6.0.Alpha1 release.
I use the following (condensed) configuration:
{
    "snapshot.locking.mode": "none",
    "connector.class": "io.debezium.connector.oracle.OracleConnector",
    "message.key.columns": "EHDA.PERS:SY_USER; EHDA.STOCKPICK:STOCKNO,PICKST;",
    "topic.creation.default.allow.auto.create.topics": "true",
    "topic.creation.default.partitions": "6",
    "signal.enabled.channels": "source",
    "topic.creation.default.auto.create.topics.enable": "true",
    "poll.interval.ms": "500",
    "signal.data.collection": "VIVU.EHDA.DBZ_SIGNAL",
    "topic.creation.default.replication.factor": "3",
    "config.providers.file.class": "org.apache.kafka.common.config.provider.FileConfigProvider",
    "key.converter": "io.confluent.connect.avro.AvroConverter",
    "schema.history.internal.producer.allow.auto.create.topics": "true",
    "database.dbname": "VIVU",
    "topic.creation.default.compression.type": "lz4",
    "key.converter.schemas.enable": "false",
    "value.converter.schemas.enable": "false",
    "name": "test-cdc-connector",
    "schema.history.internal.producer.auto.create.topics.enable": "true",
    "max.batch.size": "10000",
    "snapshot.mode": "initial",
    "schema.history.internal.consumer.allow.auto.create.topics": "true",
    "max.queue.size": "40000",
    "tasks.max": "1",
    "log.mining.strategy": "online_catalog",
    "schema.history.internal.consumer.auto.create.topics.enable": "true",
    "schema.history.internal.store.only.captured.databases.ddl": "true",
    "schema.history.internal.store.only.captured.tables.ddl": "true",
    "value.converter.enhanced.avro.schema.support": "true",
    "topic.prefix": "dbzvivalditest",
    "decimal.handling.mode": "double",
    "schema.history.internal.kafka.topic": "dbzvivalditest.schema-changes.vivaldi-cdc-connector",
    "topic.creation.default.key.converter.schemas.enable": "false",
    "value.converter": "io.confluent.connect.avro.AvroConverter",
    "topic.creation.default.cleanup.policy": "compact",
    "topic.creation.default.value.converter.schemas.enable": "false",
    "snapshot.max.threads": "54",
    "table.include.list": "EHDA.DBZ_SIGNAL, EHDA.PERS, EHDA.STOCKPICK"
}
I insert a snapshot signal into the source signal table:
INSERT INTO EHDA.DBZ_SIGNAL
(
    ID,
    TYPE,
    DATA
)
VALUES
(
    '13',
    'execute-snapshot',
    '{"data-collections":["VIVU.EHDA.STOCKPICK"],"type":"incremental"}'
);
I can see that the connector gets the signal, but it does not snapshot any data.
I find this snippet "and surrogate key 'PK of table will be used'" in the logs interesting. The table does not have a primary key constraint, but I have supplied a surrogate key via the "message.key.columns" config, so I expect the connector to use that.
I have attached a log file.
AdHocIncrementalSnapshot.log

evidence.quote: I beleive the culprits are schema.history.internal.store.only.captured.tables.ddl... So the table schema is not stored in the internal schema representation

notes: With store.only.captured.tables.ddl, a newly added table has no schema, so the snapshot signal is silently ignored ('Schema not found'). Reporter confirmed that recovering the schema fixed it.
